name: Foundational Ball Control & Finishing
objective: Develop adaptable dribble control and master finishing through contact and in chaotic situations.

drills.name: Off-Hand Freestyle
drills.description: Dribble continuously with your weak hand, using any moves you want. Stay low and keep your eyes up.

drills.name: Over-Line Pulls
drills.description: Place the ball over a line on the court, then quickly pull it back with a sharp in-and-out or crossover move. Alternate hands.

drills.name: Net Tap Finishes
drills.description: Start under the rim. Jump up and tap the net with the ball before finishing a layup. Helps with body control and finishing high. Alternate sides.

drills.name: Body-Touch Finishing
drills.description: Drive from the wing. As you gather for the layup, touch the ball to your hip or shoulder to protect it from defenders before finishing.

drills.name: The Finisher's Gauntlet
drills.description: Make 20 layups from various angles around the hoop as quickly as you can. The clock stops when you hit 20 makes.

name: Game-Speed Attack & Counters
objective: Train your ability to read situations and make split-second decisions with the ball.

drills.name: Read & React Stimulus
drills.description: The app will give a random audio/visual cue. React instantly and perform the move at game speed.

drills.name: Hesitation Pull-up
drills.description: Attack the elbow, use a hard hesitation dribble to freeze the imaginary defender, then rise up for a jump shot. Make 10.

drills.name: Shot Fake & Drive
drills.description: Catch the ball on the wing, give a hard shot fake, and then attack the rim for a layup. Perform 10 drives.

drills.name: In-and-Out Dribble Attack
drills.description: Focus on using the in-and-out dribble as your primary move to attack the basket for a layup. Make 10 layups.

name: Explosive Athleticism
objective: Build foundational basketball athleticism, focusing on vertical jump, quickness, and defensive posture.

drills.name: Line Jumps
drills.description: Find a line on the court. Perform quick, two-footed jumps back and forth over the line.

drills.name: Broad Jumps
drills.description: From a standstill, jump as far forward as you can, landing softly and under control. Reset after each jump.

drills.name: Defensive Slides
drills.description: Get in a low defensive stance and slide back and forth along the baseline. Stay low and do not cross your feet.

drills.name: Approach Jumps
drills.description: Take two powerful steps and explode upwards, reaching as high as you can with both hands, as if grabbing a rebound.
